data.title: One-Pager.pdf
data.message: Ada Founder has sent you One-Pager.pdf to sign via Cofoundaz.
data.legal_caveat: These are simple electronic signatures: each signer typed their name to adopt it as their signature. Cofoundaz records the signer's email, IP address, browser, the time and the document's SHA-256 hash, but does not issue a certificate-based or qualified signature and is not a trust service provider. Whether a typed-name signature is enforceable depends on the document and the jurisdiction; take legal advice for high-stakes agreements.
